ValidationRule.description: Validates that the Librarian's phone number contains exactly 10 numeric digits before the record can be saved. This ensures consistent contact information and prevents invalid phone number formats such as letters, special characters, or numbers with fewer
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISBLANK( Phone__c ) ), NOT( REGEX( Phone__c ,"^[0-9]{10}$")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Phone Number must contain exactly 10 digits.
